              "      async function convertToInteractive(key) {\n",
              "        const element = document.querySelector('#df-859255fe-38d9-4285-a3fc-fbf2efb273a4');\n",
              "        const dataTable =\n",
              "          await google.colab.kernel.invokeFunction('convertToInteractive',\n",
              "                                                    [key], {});\n",
              "        if (!dataTable) return;\n",
              "\n",
              "        const docLinkHtml = 'Like what you see? Visit the ' +\n",
              "          '<a target=\"_blank\" href=https://colab.research.google.com/notebooks/data_table.ipynb>data table notebook</a>'\n",
              "          + ' to learn more about interactive tables.';\n",
              "        element.innerHTML = '';\n",
              "        dataTable['output_type'] = 'display_data';\n",
              "        await google.colab.output.renderOutput(dataTable, element);\n",
              "        const docLink = document.createElement('div');\n",
              "        docLink.innerHTML = docLinkHtml;\n",
              "        element.appendChild(docLink);\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    </script>\n",
              "  </div>\n",
              "\n",
              "\n",

        "## Data Quality Audit Findings\n",
        "\n",
        "The initial audit revealed several data-quality issues that need to be addressed before customer-level analysis and segmentation.\n",
        "\n",
        "### Key Findings\n",
        "\n",
        "- The dataset contains 541,909 transaction records across 8 columns.\n",
        "- `CustomerID` has 135,080 missing values (24.93%).\n",
        "- `Description` has 1,454 missing values (0.27%).\n",
        "- There are 5,268 duplicate rows.\n",
        "- There are 10,624 transactions with negative quantities.\n",
        "- 9,288 invoices begin with `C`, indicating cancellation transactions in the dataset.\n",
        "- `InvoiceDate` is already stored in datetime format.\n",
        "- There are 4,372 unique CustomerIDs.\n",
        "\n",
        "### Initial Interpretation\n",
        "\n",
        "The missing CustomerID values are particularly important because this project focuses on customer-level analysis and segmentation. Transactions without an identifiable customer cannot be reliably assigned to a customer segment.\n",
        "\n",
        "Negative quantities also require investigation because they may represent returned or cancelled transactions rather than simple data-entry errors.\n",
        "\n",
        "Duplicate records and invalid/suspicious price values will also be investigated before the final cleaning rules are applied.\n",
        "\n",
        "### Next Step\n",
        "\n",
        "The next stage will be to define and apply appropriate data-cleaning rules while preserving legitimate business transactions."
